title: Peek utility does not run

status.label: Needs Peek settings details
status.detail: The report combines startup, shortcut, and unexpected-activation symptoms. The latest comment says Spacebar is configured but Ctrl+Space is required; current code has separate shortcut and single-Space settings.

next_action: Request the current Peek shortcut/toggle values and separate reproduction steps for each symptom.

judgment.rationale: The original report includes a June bug-report archive and several symptoms; the October comment narrows one to Spacebar requiring Ctrl+Space. Current main has separate ActivationShortcut and EnableSpaceToActivate settings with a special single-Space focus hook, so the exact configured values and which symptom occurs in the current build are needed before selecting a fix.
evidence: The issue is open, unassigned, and labeled Issue-Bug, Area-Setup/Install, Needs-Triage, and Product-Peek.
The body reports shortcut failure until a tray interaction, occasional startup failure, and unwanted activation while renaming in File Explorer; a June 2026 bug-report ZIP is attached.
A 2026-10-23 commenter says Ctrl+Space is required although the shortcut is set to Spacebar.

At upstream main 0b1dd814878f0dfbb07787d9c3e52a2897b6f769, Peek dllmain.cpp reads ActivationShortcut separately from EnableSpaceToActivate (lines 111-138); single-Space activation has a separate foreground-eligibility hook (lines 141-167, 624-633).
The current UI-test helper configures Ctrl+Space while disabling single-Space activation; that test setup does not establish whether the issue reproduces with the reporter's bare-Space configuration.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact current Peek settings and isolate the Spacebar symptom from startup and text-entry activation before proposing a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code change may be appropriate, but the report does not distinguish an ActivationShortcut mismatch from the separate single-Space toggle/focus path, and the startup and text-entry symptoms may be independent.

issue_context.summary: The report bundles Peek shortcut failure, delayed activation after tray interaction, startup behavior, and unwanted Space activation while renaming; a later commenter reports needing Ctrl+Space despite configuring Spacebar.
known_information: The body says the problem occurs from PowerToys 0.97.2 onward, uses the Microsoft Store installation, and includes a June 2026 bug-report ZIP.
The body describes shortcut failure until tray interaction, occasional startup failure, and unexpected activation during File Explorer rename.
A 2026-10-23 commenter says Ctrl+Space is needed despite setting Spacebar.
Current main has distinct ActivationShortcut and EnableSpaceToActivate settings; the latter controls a separate single-Space foreground hook.
inferences: The Spacebar symptom could be a mismatch between the global shortcut setting and the separate single-Space toggle, but the current configuration is unknown.
The tray/startup and text-entry symptoms may have different causes from the reported Ctrl+Space requirement.
issue_context.analysis: Current source has a distinct code path for bare-Space activation and foreground eligibility. The report does not provide both setting values or current-build reproduction details, so avoid treating the symptoms as one defect or requesting a generic log bundle. A June archive exists, but a fresh archive is useful only if the current activation failure still reproduces.

Read current upstream source at 0b1dd814878f0dfbb07787d9c3e52a2897b6f769: src/modules/peek/peek/dllmain.cpp:111-167 and :624-633, plus current Peek UI-test settings.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Peek Spacebar activation consistent with its settings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a bare-Space ActivationShortcut and the separate EnableSpaceToActivate toggle can be configured or interpreted differently, causing the user to need Ctrl+Space or allowing activation during text entry. The current report does not establish whether either setting is enabled, and this hypothesis does not yet explain the startup symptom.
plan: Capture the current ActivationShortcut and EnableSpaceToActivate values and reproduce the reported shortcut behavior on a current build.
Test the single-Space and modifier-shortcut paths separately in Explorer, including a filename-edit field, and record the first point where behavior diverges.
If confirmed, make the setting contract explicit and ensure the single-Space hook respects intended foreground eligibility; investigate startup separately if it persists.
verification: With the stated settings, Peek activates from the configured shortcut after a clean start.
Space does not unexpectedly activate Peek while the user is editing a filename or another text field.
Startup behavior is recorded separately and is not claimed fixed by a shortcut-only change.

confidence.rationale: Current source confirms distinct settings and focus-gating code, but the live report does not include their values or isolate the three symptoms.

actions.label: Request Peek settings and repro steps

comment.body:
Thanks for the detailed report and the June bug-report archive. The October comment says Ctrl+Space is required even though Spacebar is configured. Current Peek has separate ActivationShortcut and "Enable single Space key activation" settings, so please share:
- The values of both settings and your current PowerToys/Windows versions.
- Separate steps for each startup, tray-interaction, or rename-field symptom that still reproduces.
- If activation still fails on the current build, add a fresh /bugreport immediately afterward; there is no need to re-upload the June archive.

actions.label: Approve Peek Spacebar activation investigation
actions.note: Keep startup and text-entry behavior separate until the exact settings and reproduction identify the failing path.

reproduce.version_requirement: Use the reporter's current supported build and record the exact version.
prerequisites: Peek enabled with its ActivationShortcut and EnableSpaceToActivate values recorded.
File Explorer available with a file rename field.
setup: Start PowerToys cleanly and configure the reported Spacebar shortcut/toggle combination.
steps: In File Explorer, select a supported file and press the configured Spacebar shortcut.
Repeat after opening and closing the PowerToys tray menu.
Place focus in a filename rename field and press Space; record whether Peek opens.
Repeat with the single-Space toggle changed while keeping the activation shortcut recorded.
reproduce.expected_result: Peek responds to the configured shortcut only in the intended foreground contexts and does not unexpectedly open while editing a filename.
